name: Knowledge
overview: Scripture reveals that true knowledge begins with the fear of the LORD, as Proverbs 1:7 teaches, contrasting the wise who seek knowledge with fools who hate it (Proverbs 1:22). The knowledge of good and evil, introduced in Genesis with the tree in Eden, carries profound spiritual consequences, including death for disobedience (Genesis 2:9, 2:17, 3:22). Believers are called to grow in knowledge through God's commandments, seeking His judgment and wisdom as a divine gift that guides life rightly (Psalms 119:66).
